scope.title: EvidencePack — Incident Investigation (example)
scope.description: Collect, preserve, and analyze digital evidence relating to a suspected unauthorized access and data exfiltration incident affecting corporate systems. This scope defines the objects, timeframe, jurisdictions, evidence types, handling rules, and objectives for the pack.
objectives: Preserve forensic artifacts for legal/disciplinary review
Extract indicators of compromise (IOCs) for containment
inclusion_criteria: Email headers and attachments for relevant accounts
Relevant IM/chat transcripts and ticketing records
exclusion_criteria: Personal data unrelated to the incident
Irrelevant archived datasets older than retention policy unless containing indicators
Third-party confidential material without proper legal access
scope.handling_instructions: All evidence must be hashed (SHA-256) at collection, stored encrypted at rest, chain-of-custody recorded, and access restricted to authorized investigators. Maintain original copies; work only on verified copies.
scope.retention_policy: Retain for 7 years or until legal hold released; destruction requires documented approval.
scope.notes: This scope is a template. Adjust timeframe, jurisdictions, and inclusion/exclusion criteria to match the actual investigation and any legal holds or regulatory constraints.
